body:
Coordinator lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-23 ~01:50Z; my own miss). A TermAl restart is NOT confined to Central. Greg restarts TermAl on every host (see central-restart-cargo-run-rebuilds-exe), and in-flight runs on satellites die with it. Observed at the b35c79d1 restart (notice 01:45:20Z): Windows B's BATCH5 full run test-594b0728 lost its tool session and launcher PID 17060, and the runner recovered it as INTERRUPTED (sourceIdAfter null, not eligible). Opus2 confirmed that Windows B's runner was restarted too.
Rule:
- Before proposing "restart now", list every in-flight launcher run and delegation child on ALL hosts (Central, Windows B, DL560 s4/C6, Mac), not only on Central.
- Either wait for them to end, or tell Greg which runs will be lost and that each gets one recover plus one repeat on identical input.
- Never write "off-Central runs are unaffected".
- After the restart, each runner recovers its run once (node scripts/test-launcher.mjs recover RUN_DIR) and repeats once on identical input in a fresh root. A test failure is never repeated.
